asllvd.name: ASLLVD research benchmark
asllvd.license: Research and education only; no redistribution or commercial use without explicit permission
asllvd.attribution: Neidle, Carol; Thangali, Ashwin; Sclaroff, Stan (2012), Challenges in Development of the American Sign Language Lexicon Video Dataset (ASLLVD) Corpus, LREC 2012. See original source for full credits and terms.
asllvd.conditions: Evaluation only. Source-annotated consultant IDs and sign start/end frames; the source describes right-hand-dominant signers, not actual physical hand per token. Keep actual hand unknown. Processed MOVs stack frontal/profile views and play all originally captured 60-fps frames at 15 fps; correct timestamps to capture time. Keep clips, source annotation subset and coordinates in ignored local caches.

signalpha_motion.name: SignAlphaSet dynamic V3
signalpha_motion.attribution: Garg, Bindu; Kasar, Manisha; Kashyap, Achyut; Vats, Amber; Sharma, Gunjan; Hange, Aditya (2025), SignAlphaSet, Mendeley Data, V3, doi:10.17632/8fmvr9m98w.3
signalpha_motion.participants: Paper reports the three static-dataset participants also recorded dynamic signs; original video filenames do not identify individual signers. Do not invent per-clip signer IDs.
signalpha_motion.conditions: No source speed, motion-size, hand, lighting or camera-angle labels. Measure duration and palm-relative trajectory extent from the originals and mark these as derived observations.
signalpha_motion.selection: Use original AVI files only, never the accompanying extracted JPG frames as independent movements. Audit video duplicates and motion quality before training.
